source.place: Tag 06YN, definition of K-flatness, with the clopen total-tensor comparison and zero insertion.

proof.text: Reindex the finite family along an equivalence I ≃ Fin n so that the gluing theorem stays in the given coefficient universe. Its exact-short-complex detection applied to the short complex in every degree gives acyclicity if and only if every restricted complex is acyclic. The zero-insertion functors have identity restriction at their own component and zero objects at every other component.

source.place: Definition K-flat (Tag 06YN), lemma-restriction-K-flat, and the finite-clopen total tensor comparison (Tag 0FPQ).

proof.text: For global K-flat P and an arbitrary acyclic complex F on component i, take the zero-insertion e_i from gluing. The structural adjunction r_i ⊣ e_i and additivity of r_i imply additivity of e_i. Degreewise insertion is acyclic: its own restriction is isomorphic to F, and every other restriction has zero terms. Tensor this global acyclic complex with P, restrict to i, and use the structural total-tensor comparison followed by the own-component insertion isomorphism. This proves that F tensor r_i(P) is acyclic, with no bound on F.

source.place: Definition K-flat (Tag 06YN), lemma-restriction-K-flat, and the finite-clopen total tensor comparison (Tag 0FPQ).

proof.text: Conversely, if all restrictions of P are K-flat, restrict any global acyclic F. Exactness detection shows each restriction of F is acyclic. Component K-flatness and the inverse total-tensor comparison give acyclicity of each restriction of F tensor P; detection then gives global acyclicity. Transport the resulting equivalence back along I ≃ Fin n. The argument includes empty index sets and zero component categories.

theorem clopen_kflat_detection
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (I : Type w) [Finite I] (Y : I → Scheme.{t})
    (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)] [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (j i)]
    (hdisjoint : Pairwise (fun i k ↦ Disjoint (Set.range (j i)) (Set.range (j k))))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (j i))
    (R : Sheaf (topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}) :
    ∀ P : CochainComplex (ClopenData.clopenTensorModules.{t, u} R) ℤ,
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := topology X) (R := R) P ↔
        ∀ i, CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := topology (Y i))
          (R := (ClopenData.clopenTensorRings.{t, u} (j i)).obj R)
          ((ClopenData.clopenTensorComplexRestriction.{t, u} (j i) R).obj P)
